newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Santa Isabel buys Marmentini stores.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Santa Isabel buys Marmentini stores.

text.p: Chilean supermarket chain Santa Isabel SA completed an agreement with Marmentini SA to buy eight Marmentini stores plus two others under construction for $19.3 million, Santa Isabel said.

Of the eight existing stores, two are located in Santiago, two in the First Region of northern Chile and four in the north-central Fifth Region. The two stores under construction are both in Santiago, said Santa Isabel.
The existing stores account for about 70 percent of Marmentini's total sales, which came to $137 million in 1995, said Santa Isabel in a statement.
Valparaiso-based Santa Isabel is Chile's largest supermarket chain with 57 stores, plus 13 in Peru and three in Paraguay.
